problem: FULL_COPY is wasteful at low divergence but memoized shared execution becomes overhead when nearly every branch has a distinct transition read signature.
candidate_policy: Choose conventional SPARSE_OVERLAY_MEMO when measured/estimated unique_read_signatures / active_branches is sufficiently low; otherwise materialize or execute branches independently. Representation conversion must preserve exact branch semantic identity/provenance/epochs.
